# Needed by test_stream_quality.py, which evaluates the real yt-dlp format
# selector against synthetic format tables. No network access is involved.
# Kept in step with the floor in ytmusic_free/manifest.json so CI exercises a
# version the provider actually claims to support.
yt-dlp>=2025.12.8
# Only the live suite needs this, to reach the radio/watch endpoint that serves
# auto-generated mixes. The offline tests stub the client out entirely.

# The AI-blocklist refresh fetches through Music Assistant's aiohttp session and
# builds an aiohttp.ClientTimeout. MA always ships aiohttp; the provider imports
# it lazily so the rest of the suite runs without it, but the tests that cover
# that refresh path need it present.
aiohttp>=3.9
